correctness.rationale: For F_2 each coordinate satisfies x_i^2=x_i, making x^2=M^T x; the exact number of idempotents is 2^dim ker(M^T-I). For a prescribed fixed r-plane U, GL_n matrices fixing U have 2^{r(n-r)} |GL_{n-r}| members. Mobius inversion on superspaces U yields the displayed Gaussian-binomial formula for every n>=1. Companion matrices of irreducibles of degree >=2 have no eigenvalue 1; n=1 is the sharp exception. Perfect natural bases are monomial and hence permutations over F_2. Independent exhaustive 2^{n^2} matrix scans through n=4 gave nullity distributions (0,1),(2,3,1),(48,98,21,1),(5824,11640,2590,105,1); orbit quotient by S_n yielded 1,8,248 classes with n4 orbit histogram 8x2,12x8,24x238.
